entities.name: Control plane only indication
entities.description: An information element included by the network to indicate that the associated PDU session is only for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that determines PDU session characteristics and includes the control plane only indication IE.

entities.name: PDU session for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization
entities.description: A condition where the network determines that the PDU session is exclusively for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

relations.description: The network includes the control plane only indication IE in relevant messages.
The presence of the control plane only indication IE is conditional on the network determining the PDU session is for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.
